Lina (finance): Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem: need firm owners for credits, invoice reissues, and a prevention owner for recurring ingest restarts. Please reply with owner + ETA.
Omar (billing-eng): I9ll take the backfill and reconciliation csv. ETA: dry-run by 2025-04-04 COB, full run 2025-04-06 AM. Output will be CSV: account_id, affected_window, credit_amount, invoice_action, run_id.
Sofia (customer-success): I9ll assemble the P0 list and draft comms. ETA draft: 2025-04-03 EOD. Will include FAQ and SLA wording.
Tariq (eng-ml): I can own the alert and the infra RCA coordination. Alert rule ready by 2025-04-02, RCA meeting week of 2025-04-14. Note: logs show consumer restarts every ~6 weeks on worker-group-2.
LedgerBot: [incident] MTR-4410 metering-delay detected 2025-03-10 03:15Z. tags: metering/delay
Lina (finance): Good. Please make backfill idempotent and include a run_id in the CSV so accounting can reconcile. Also we need a short audit summary for external invoices.
Omar (billing-eng): Will do. Adding validation harness sampling top-8 by MRR. Will post dry-run logs here with checksum.
Sofia (customer-success): Uploaded P0 list: https://internal.redwood/cs/p0_metering_2025-03.xlsx. I9ll notify customers when credits are visible.
Tariq (eng-ml): Alert snippet to add to runbook: if ingest_lag_secs > 300 && queued_tokens > 1500 -> create ticket & page oncall. Posting snippet to BILL-4410.
Lina (finance): Timeline recap: dry-run 2025-04-04, full run 2025-04-06, comms 2025-04-03, alert 2025-04-02, RCA week of 2025-04-14. Target close: 2025-04-18.
Omar (billing-eng): Starting dry-run branch now. run_id=backfill-20250402-01. Will attach logs. :thumbsup:
LedgerBot: [job] scheduled backfill-20250402-01 on billing-cluster-5
Sofia (customer-success): Thanks. Please ping me if any amounts need manual review before customer notification.
Lina (finance): I'll create a simple action tracker and schedule weekly check-ins until resolved. Meeting invite coming for Mon 9am PT.
Omar (billing-eng): Dry-run brief:
```
processed: 610 accounts (sample)
potential_credits_tokens: 1,982,340
manual_review: 4
checksum: a3f5c2b1
```
Lina (finance): Great progress. Post any blockers here. We'll confirm invoice reissue plan after validation.
